label: 全部为实测；安装包体积为文件字节数换算；图谱构建为 release WebView2 内的 JS 计时，不含首帧绘制。

index.method: cargo test --release bench_index -- --ignored --nocapture; body 1521 chars, real sample body; measured on a temp vault

search.method: Store::search_notes in the same release benchmark; 30 FTS iterations, 10 LIKE-fallback iterations

annotationWrite.method: 100 add_annotation + delete_annotation cycles in the same release benchmark

runToRunVariance.note: two benchmark runs on the same machine; report the slower first-run values in the headline table

localGraph.method: actual src/lib/graph.ts localGraph(), 30 random notes per size, Node 22.23.2

startup.method: tools/measure-app.ps1, 5 runs, final release build, 1456x939, sample vault, idle 4s; app-ready from Rust Instant log; memory is the sum of 7 processes

memoryOverTime.method: tools/memory-over-time.ps1, one idle instance, final release

startup.note: window-visible and app-ready are not pixel-on-screen; app-ready is after the first note DOM and invoke. The first run after a full build has a 484ms window-visible outlier; the next four are 62-77ms. Private bytes is the better single memory number; working set double-counts shared WebView2 DLL pages.

memoryBreakdown.method: one idle instance, sum of the app process tree
memoryBreakdown.note: one idle instance from an earlier build; the final release total is 257.9-263.2MB private at 4s (median 260.1). The process split is indicative, not re-sampled.

package.nsisInstallTest: final 5.29MiB build: exit 0; installed to D:\Develop\yebian-installed; app launched; uninstall exit 0; folder removed

behavior.annotationE2E: add -> SQLite row -> reload -> edit source -> orphan card -> revert -> re-anchor -> delete -> SQLite count 0
behavior.singleInstance: second launch exits in 1075ms; process count stayed 1
behavior.vaultFallback: saved path missing -> falls back to bundled sample-vault, rewrites setting, path displayed without \\?\ prefix
behavior.searchAfterFtsMigration: query 养老金 returned the social-security note in the release build
behavior.graphUi: local Canvas graph: hover tooltip + particles, drag, fullscreen overlay with zoom/pan, related-note navigation verified (shots/graph-navigate2.png); no rAF while idle
behavior.fullGraph: topbar 图谱: DOM/SVG force graph; semantic zoom (dots at far, cards at near); click focuses and opens a panel (does not navigate); search, kind filters, BFS path; verified on the 4-note sample in the final release

localGraphLayout.method: layoutLocalGraph (pure force layout), 300 runs per size, 10 nodes; Node 22.23.2
localGraphLayout.note: the 1k p95 includes JIT warm-up; p50 is the steady cost

forceGraph.method: GraphView.build() performance.now() inside the final release WebView2 156, 1456x939; includes 320 force ticks, rectangle/circle collision relaxation, DOM construction and first fit; excludes CSS first-frame paint. Repeated via tools/measure-force-many.mjs; corpus from tools/make-bench-vault.mjs.
forceGraph.note: The 200-note build blocks the click for its duration; there is no worker and no post-build rAF loop. Default is recent 40 for legibility, not because 80/200 fail performance.
